global_style: An elegant, minimalist template featuring an earthy 'Morandi' palette and organic, brush-edged circular motifs for a warm, artistic aesthetic.

identity_anchors: Muted, earthy color palette applied in large, flat blocks.
Organic, rough-edged 'dry brush' circles used as background elements and focal containers.
High negative space with generous margins surrounding structured content.
Intersection of rigid geometric containers (rectangles) with soft/organic shapes (circles).

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
